title: A Honey Cocktail Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Kogoro Mouri) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved. case_type: murder. Transcript gives no established motive for the mayor or the secretary -- v1 marked the culprit's own motive 'unspecified' but the full transcript actually reveals it clearly (resentment + a broken promise); the other two suspects genuinely have none stated, so has_motive_against stays only on the true culprit here.

attrs.died_of: head injury from a fall off the balcony railing, after fleeing a staged wasp attack
attrs.wasp_phobia: traumatic fear of wasps since being nearly killed by a swarm in sixth grade
attrs.broken_promise: had promised to make Aihara manager of the new spa resort, then reneged

attrs.motive_summary: resented being treated as a servant despite once saving Yamazaki's life, after she reneged on her promise to make him manager of the new spa resort; wanted to ruin the next day's ground-breaking ceremony
attrs.method_summary: rigged a balloon-and-bag apparatus with ether-stunned wasps inside the office chimney, smeared honey on the inside doorknob to direct her toward the window instead of the door, pre-corroded the balcony railing with sulfuric acid, then phoned her up to the room and released the wasps by pulling a fishing line from the kitchen while everyone else was downstairs

locations.name: Yamazaki mansion upstairs office (locked room with balcony)

objects.name: Honey smeared on the inside doorknob

attrs.purpose: drew the panicked wasps toward the door and away from the window, so President Yamazaki fled toward the window instead

objects.name: Balloon-and-bag wasp release rig hidden in the chimney

attrs.mechanism: a bag of ether-stunned wasps taped shut and attached to a balloon, wedged in the chimney (with the chimney's rain cap removed); fishing line ran from the balloon and from a piece of tape covering a pre-made rip in the bag, both fed through a small hole in the office floor down to the kitchen
attrs.trigger: pulling the line from the kitchen tore the tape off the rip, releasing the wasps into the room; the balloon blocked the chimney top so they flew inward instead of escaping
attrs.disposal: after the murder, Aihara released the balloon out of the chimney by pulling the second thread; it was meant to fly off but got stuck in a tree downstream due to rain and wind, where Conan and Ran happened to spot it

attrs.mechanism: pre-weakened in advance so it would give way when Yamazaki leaned on it while fending off the wasps

attrs.purpose: worn to safely gather and ether-stun the wasps used in the rig
attrs.note: weak evidence on its own since most households in the area own one

attrs.claimed_use: Aihara claimed they were leftovers from making balloons for kids at a summer festival
attrs.anomaly: three tanks is more than that explanation accounts for, consistent instead with repeated balloon test flights for the chimney rig

objects.name: Fishing line/thread found in Aihara's pocket

attrs.match: matches the thread used to pull the tape off the wasp bag
attrs.circumstance: Aihara hadn't yet disposed of it when the mayor and Conan interrupted him, or had let his guard down once the death was ruled an accident

attrs.note: Yamazaki always kept it on hand against wasps; she was spraying it as she fled toward the balcony

attrs.found_residue: traces of honey, from wiping his hands after smearing the doorknob

clues.desc: The honey was smeared specifically on the inside doorknob, not anywhere else in the room. Since a wasp swarm inside a room would normally send someone fleeing straight for the door, the honey-drawn wasps blocked that route instead, explaining why Yamazaki fled the opposite way, through the window, to a balcony with a pre-weakened railing.

Three helium tanks were found in the shed, more than Aihara's claimed explanation (leftover balloons for a summer festival) accounts for -- consistent instead with repeated test flights needed to get a bag-carrying balloon to travel and clear the chimney reliably.

pre-corrodes the balcony railing with sulfuric acid
smears honey on the underside of the inside doorknob

edges.method: released a bag of wasps into her locked office via a balloon rig hidden in the chimney; the honey-baited doorknob blocked her escape through the door and drove her toward the window and balcony instead, where she fell to her death off a railing pre-corroded with sulfuric acid

edges.detail: returns to the kitchen and releases the second thread, sending the balloon out of the chimney; it was meant to fly off but got caught in a tree downstream

edges.motive_type: resentment over servitude and a broken promise of promotion (true motive)
